threads.title: The seventh week and the elect of the eternal plant of righteousness
threads.summary_md: Enoch's Apocalypse-of-Weeks turns on the close of the seventh age and the choosing of a faithful remnant: *And after that in the seventh week shall arise a perverse generation, And many shall be its deeds, But all its deeds shall be apostasy.* (1 Enoch 91:11) *And at its close shall be elected The elect righteous of the eternal plant of righteousness, To receive sevenfold instruction concerning all His creation.* (1 Enoch 91:12) The "eternal plant" is no church grafted in by confession but the seed-line itself — Israel as Yahuah's own planting: *Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.* (Isaiah 60:21) That election runs ahead of any hearing, surviving even the apostate generation as a kept remnant: *Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.* (Romans 11:5) Enoch's weeks are measured the way Daniel measures them — a determined span sealed to His people and His holy city: *Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.* (Daniel 9:24) Within Enoch the elect are those who hold the way of life and not idols: *And now, my sons, listen to me: The paths of righteousness are these: To walk in truth and righteousness, To love mercy and truth, To do judgment and righteousness, To walk humbly with Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 93:5) The "sevenfold instruction" given them is the wisdom that ends in glory: *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* (Daniel 12:3)

members.note: Isaiah 60:21 — *Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.* Enoch's "eternal plant of righteousness" is Yahuah's own planting — Israel the seed-line, not a people grafted in by confession.

Romans 11:5 — *Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.* The elect chosen at the close of the apostate seventh week are a kept remnant, election running ahead of and through the perverse generation.

Daniel 9:24 — *Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.* Enoch's Apocalypse of Weeks is measured the same way — a determined span sealed to His people and His holy city, ending the transgression of the apostate week.

Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* The "sevenfold instruction" given the elect is the wisdom of the righteous that ends in shining glory.

1 Enoch 93:5 — *And now, my sons, listen to me: The paths of righteousness are these: To walk in truth and righteousness, To love mercy and truth, To do judgment and righteousness, To walk humbly with Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* Enoch's own definition of the way that the elect of the eternal plant keep — the Torah-way of life, never the curse.

threads.title: Who can behold the Holy One — the unsearchable Creator
threads.summary_md: Enoch sets the elect's sevenfold instruction against the bottomless mystery of the Maker, that none should boast of comprehending Him: *For who is there of all the children of men That is able to hear the voice of the Holy One without being troubled? And who can think His thoughts? And who is there that can behold all the works of heaven?* (1 Enoch 91:13) *And there is none upon the earth that could see Him, Or could understand what He does, Or could search out His works.* (1 Enoch 91:15) This is the very confession of Job's friend: *Canst thou by searching find out Elohim (God)? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?* (Job 11:7) and of Isaiah, who set the Creator past all counsel: *Who hath directed the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD), or being his counsellor hath taught him?* (Isaiah 40:13) — *there is no searching of his understanding.* (Isaiah 40:28) Paul breaks into the same doxology: *O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of Elohim (God)! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!* (Romans 11:33) The Father is formless and unseen — *No man hath seen Elohim (God) at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.* (John 1:18) — *whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.* (1 Timothy 6:16) Enoch's elect do not ascend to comprehend the Head of Days; the unseen Father is declared only through the Formed Son.

members.note: Job 11:7 — *Canst thou by searching find out Elohim (God)? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?* Enoch's question — who can think the Holy One's thoughts — is Job's confession that none can search out the Almighty to perfection.

Isaiah 40:28 — *Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that El Olam (the everlasting God), Yahuah (LORD), the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.* Enoch's "none upon the earth could search out His works" is Isaiah's "there is no searching of his understanding."

Romans 11:33 — *O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of Elohim (God)! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!* Paul breaks into the same wonder Enoch voices — the Maker's ways past finding out.

John 1:18 — *No man hath seen Elohim (God) at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.* The Head of Days is formless and unseen; the unseen Father is made known only through the Formed Son, the Son of Adam.

1 Timothy 6:16 — *Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.* "None upon the earth that could see Him" — the Father dwells in unapproachable light, whom no man can see.

threads.title: The sinners pervert the words; the righteous keep them exactly
threads.summary_md: Enoch ends the chapter with a warning over the words themselves — that men would corrupt the way of life by adding, twisting, and lying: *And now I know that the sinners shall alter and pervert the words of righteousness In many ways, And shall speak wicked words, And lie, And practice great deceits, And write books concerning their words.* (1 Enoch 91:18) The safeguard is the command first given at Sinai — neither add nor diminish: *Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) which I command you.* (Deuteronomy 4:2) The same seal closes the canon: *For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, Elohim (God) shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:* (Revelation 22:18) *And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, Elohim (God) shall take away his part out of the book of life...* (Revelation 22:19) Enoch's promise to the faithful copyists — *But when they write all my words in their languages, And they do not change or diminish aught from my words But write them all exactly as I speak them, Then I know another mystery, That the books will be given to the righteous and the wise To become a joy and a cause of honour to the wise.* (1 Enoch 91:19) — frames Torah and the books as a kept inheritance, the way of life that the righteous transmit unaltered. The corruption is the sin; faithful transmission is the keeping of the covenant.

members.note: Deuteronomy 4:2 — *Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) which I command you.* The sinners' perverting of the words of righteousness is the breach of the Sinai command to neither add to nor diminish from His word.

Revelation 22:18 — *For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, Elohim (God) shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:* The same seal that closes the canon guards Enoch's words — copy them exactly, neither adding nor changing.

Revelation 22:19 — *And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, Elohim (God) shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.* Enoch's faithful who diminish nothing from his words inherit the books as a joy; those who take away forfeit their part.
